deployments_detail.use: AI collaboration (Avayl/Elsevier Life Sciences) for drug-discovery use of AI

AI-driven yield optimization at Recordati's Ireland manufacturing plant: Aizon Predict used predictive regression and time-series models to identify critical process parameters behind a >4% yield drop, then implemented targeted process changes (e.g., optimized drying time). [Aizon (Aizon Predict)]
deployments_detail.value: 1.5% yield increase; 2% COGS reduction within 3 months

deployments_detail.use: Manufacturing data unification for AI analysis: Aizon Unify integrated fragmented GxP data sources (process data, material attributes, batch records, sensor/IoT data) into a single platform to enable AI-based root-cause and process analysis. [Aizon (Aizon Unify)]

AI evidence screening/triage grounded in a licensed biomedical database: MedPro integrated with Elsevier's Embase to let Medical Information teams screen searches and build responses from a single controlled, version-tracked evidence base. [AVAYL (MedPro) + Elsevier (Embase/ScienceDirect)]
Partnership with Healthily (medical AI) to redefine services for professionals, pharmacists, patients in Italy

Generative AI drafting of compliant, evidence-based Medical Information responses to physician/HCP inquiries in Recordati Rare Diseases' Global Medical Information team, using AVAYL MedPro (moved from pilot to production). [AVAYL (MedPro)]
deployments_detail.value: Response delivered within ~1 hour vs. typical multi-day turnaround

deployments_detail.use: AI-assisted systematic literature review/search automation within the Medical Information workflow, letting specialists surface relevant evidence far faster than manual review. [AVAYL (MedPro)]
Real-time process monitoring dashboards and automation of previously manual production workflows in the GxP-compliant cloud platform, deployed after the AI analysis at Recordati Ireland. [Aizon]

Audit-ready, governed generative AI for Medical Information: MedPro provides transparent source trails, role-based approvals, and copyright/IP-compliant content handling to meet regulatory/audit requirements for AI-generated medical responses. [AVAYL (MedPro)]
